name: Kinetra docs
install: git config --global user.name 'Philipp Molitor' && git config --global user.email 'git@molitor.dev' && git config --local user.name 'Philipp Molitor' && git config --local user.email 'git@molitor.dev' && if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" ] && ! command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh; fi; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; grep -q 'mise activate bash' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'eval "$(~/.local/bin/mise activate bash)"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; mise trust && mise install && eval "$(mise activate bash --shims)" && corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
